tasks.title: Change calculator title from Chris's Cal to Chris's Calculator
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Update the app title text from "Chris's Cal" to "Chris's Calculator" wherever it appears. 2. READ FIRST: Read /home/ubuntu/.eunomia/workspace/eunomia-mini-calculator/index.html and /home/ubuntu/.eunomia/workspace/eunomia-mini-calculator/src/App.tsx to find all occurrences of "Chris's Cal". 3. FILES: Modify index.html (page <title> tag) and src/App.tsx (h1 heading or any visible title text) if they contain "Chris's Cal". 4. APPROACH: Simple string replacement — change every occurrence of "Chris's Cal" (that is not already "Chris's Calculator") to "Chris's Calculator". 5. PATTERNS: Follow the same pattern used in previous title changes in this project.
acceptance_criteria: index.html <title> tag contains "Chris's Calculator" and not the standalone "Chris's Cal"
The visible h1 heading in src/App.tsx reads "Chris's Calculator"
npx tsc --noEmit exits code 0 with no TypeScript errors
